prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1014; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported neck and back pain. The described mechanism of injury is consistent in type and force with the strain pattern identified on examination. Imaging and physical findings clearly support the diagnosis of cervical and lumbar strain. The patient has no known prior injury to the neck or back. Over the course of 18 visits, care included manual therapy, guided exercise, and home stretching. Symptoms improved steadily, and the frequency of visits was reduced as function returned, consistent with a typical recovery course. At the most recent evaluation, range of motion had nearly returned to baseline and residual discomfort was limited to occasional stiffness with prolonged sitting. Billing records include two similar charges posted on the same day, which are under routine review. Continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up are recommended.
